name: OpenCidian by Perxel
attribution: OpenCidian by Perxel; includes CC-CEDICT and CVDICT data and the upstream sources listed in OpenCidian dist/meta.json.
notes: HL-03-02 built the pinned source byte-idempotently and recorded the artifact checksum and entry count.
Only reviewed entries with simplified Hanzi, pinyin and non-empty Vietnamese senses may enter the HanLearn corpus.
Missing examples stay empty; missing levels stay null. AI must not fill canonical dictionary fields.
Independent Vietnamese linguistic review is a separate gate before Phase 03 can be accepted for release.
